senses.gloss: (sec. r. of קוּט or קָטַט) [to cut; to shrink], v. קָנִיט.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 3:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. III</cite> <he>בוכה אני שהִקְנַטְתִּי את אבא</he> (ed. Bub. <he>שהכעסתי</he>) I weep because I provoked my father. Pesik. Shubah, p. 165ᵃ <he>לא … לא הִקְנַטְנוּ אותו</he> have we not provoked him to anger? have we not annoyed him? <cite ref="Chullin 122b">Ḥull. 122ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 55b">55ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אל תַּקְנִיטֵנִי שבלשון יחיד וכ׳</he> do not weary me (with thy arguments), for I am teaching this as an individual opinion (not as an adopted rule); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to shrink, fail. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. Thazriʿa 4 נפשו מַקְנֶטֶת עליו (Ms. R. קניטה) his soul within him would faint (ed. Tanḥ. 3 מצירה).—V. קָנִיט.
